title: Figure AI Helix-02 humanoid fleet runs autonomous 8-hour warehouse shift
summary: Figure AI demonstrated a fleet of humanoid robots completing an autonomous 8-hour warehouse shift powered by the Helix-02 neural network. All inference runs on board, and the robots coordinate, autonomously swap batteries and self-route to maintenance without human intervention.

web_findings.title: Introducing Helix 02: Full-Body Autonomy
web_findings.snippet: Unified neural network for walking, manipulation, balance and coordination with onboard sensors and full-body control.

web_findings.title: Figure AI's humanoid completes 8-hour warehouse shift using Helix-02
web_findings.snippet: Helix-02 humanoids approach human-level package handling speed in live demo.

web_findings.title: Figure AI Robot Sorts 100,000 Packages in 81 Hours
web_findings.snippet: Subsequent runs extended endurance well past initial 8-hour goal.
